name: Éalú
summary:
Éalú is an entirely hand-animated, stop-motion, point & click adventure. A cozy experience... unless the maze takes a darker turn... Guide your wooden mouse through a labyrinth full of puzzles & unknown dangers in search of an exit to a happier place.

Éalú is a 2 to 4 hour long, meditative experience, depending on how deeply you explore the maze, focused on physical craft and reflection - made by a independent team of four artists: Ivan Fisher-Owen (Concept, writing & animation), Ben Orr (Dev/Programming & writing), Will Wood (Musical composition & recording) & JT Paton (Illustrations).
